cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(color_entry_fixture C CXX)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
if(NOT CUI_LIBRARY)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set CUI_LIBRARY to a matching built libcui.a")
endif()
add_library(color_entry STATIC ${CUI_SOURCE}/src/base/cui_color_entry.c ${CUI_SOURCE}/src/components/cui_color_entry.c)
target_include_directories(color_entry PUBLIC ${CUI_SOURCE}/include)
target_compile_options(color_entry PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
target_link_libraries(color_entry PUBLIC ${CUI_LIBRARY} m)
add_executable(test_color_entry ${CUI_SOURCE}/tests/unit/test_color_entry.c)
add_executable(test_color_entry_header ${CUI_SOURCE}/tests/unit/test_color_entry_header.cpp)
add_executable(test_color_entry_owner ${CUI_SOURCE}/tests/unit/test_color_entry_owner.c)
add_executable(test_color_entry_picker_regression ${CUI_SOURCE}/tests/unit/test_picker.c)
add_executable(test_color_entry_picker_events_regression ${CUI_SOURCE}/tests/unit/test_picker_events.c)
add_executable(test_color_entry_input_regression ${CUI_SOURCE}/tests/unit/test_input.c)
foreach(target test_color_entry test_color_entry_header test_color_entry_owner test_color_entry_picker_regression test_color_entry_picker_events_regression test_color_entry_input_regression)
  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE color_entry)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -UNDEBUG)
endforeach()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME color_entry COMMAND test_color_entry)
add_test(NAME color_entry_header COMMAND test_color_entry_header)
add_test(NAME color_entry_owner COMMAND test_color_entry_owner)
add_test(NAME color_entry_picker_regression COMMAND test_color_entry_picker_regression)
add_test(NAME color_entry_picker_events_regression COMMAND test_color_entry_picker_events_regression)
add_test(NAME color_entry_input_regression COMMAND test_color_entry_input_regression)
